method: RI-WLD04 M18 — differentiation measured on the built world
note: Replaces region-axes@1, in which 8 of 9 axes were string or hex comparisons against game/data/world/regions.json (verdict W1-01 §4d). Every axis here names its source; 13 are measured off built geometry or replicated renderer placement and 2 off rendered pixels, and 1 off RENDERED SOUND (W1-22: the audio axis was dropped as unmeasurable while audioMB was 0; it is now the spectrum of PCM the engine actually rendered). Unmeasurable axes are dropped, not scored.

axes.source: built terrain (heightAt mean and p10-p90 spread)
built water (depthAt at all four tide phases)
renderer ground shader replicated over built ground and built depth (CIELAB dE)
province.js prop lattice replicated: instances the renderer places
same lattice: placed crown height and radius, not the table row
built terrain: the region’s own micro-relief field sampled on a 3 m lattice along four 240 m transects — the shape of the ORDINARY ground, not of its landmark

built ground skin: the region’s own sub-metre surface sampled on the skin mesh’s own 0.55 m cell along four 110 m transects — the ordinary ground at the scale a standing player reads it, which is what the bottom half of every frame is made of
the renderer’s own scatter lattice with the renderer’s own rolls: nearest-neighbour distance, its coefficient of variation and the Clark-Evans dispersion index
built terrain: heightAt minus naturalHeightAt on a 12 m lattice — how much of the region’s ground IS its ONLY-HERE element, and which way it displaces
placed structures: solid signature instances and road deck spans standing in the region (RI-WLD04 M18 architecture, un-dropped)
hazard volumes present in the region, by class multiset and signature (un-dropped: reports/hazard-fire.json shows 19/19 firing)
rendered pixels: mean CIELAB of the region’s M17 frames, top and upper-middle bands
rendered pixels: the sky/canopy/ground CIELAB profile down the frame
rendered sound: level-normalised 24-band spectrum of the PCM Engine.ambienceCapture() rendered for this region

dropped_axes.reason: no enemy or creature is placed in any region in this build; a fauna axis scored off a table row would read 78/78 on an empty province
weather is a per-frame capture parameter, not a property of the built world; it enters through rendered_palette when the M17 night and worst-weather passes are captured
